bias.en: Breakdown · new low since listing, SAR flipped bearish
bias.zh: 破位 · 创上市以来新低，SAR 转空

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 13.4% on Nov 5 to $123.90, trading between $122.50 and $134.07 on heavy volume; there is no 100-day yet (84 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($142.9) and 30-day ($160.1) and the rising 10-day ($146.7) averages. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 5, below zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 5 ($166.06), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月5日下跌 13.4%，收于 $123.90，盘中区间 $122.50–134.07，成交量明显放大；上市仅 84 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$142.9）和 30 日均线（$160.1）以及上行的 10 日均线（$146.7）下方。MACD 于 11月5日下穿信号线，位于零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 于 11月5日转为看空（$166.06），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The drop broke the $141.2, $139.2–139.9 and $133.8–134.2 supports and the Oct 22 ($130.8) and Jul 29 ($124.8) lows, all now resistance; the $122.50 low is the lowest since listing. Resistance is $124.8, then $130.8–134.1 (Oct 22 and Aug 7 lows, Nov 5 high) and $141.2–142.9 (5-day). Support is $122.5, then $120. A close above $124.8 would target $131–134; below $122.5, $120.

r.en: Oct 22 low $130.79; Aug 7 low $133.8; Nov 5 high $134.07

bias.en: Rebound failed · lost ₩1.3 million, SAR bearish
bias.zh: 反弹失败 · 跌破 130 万韩元，SAR 转空

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul close is ₩1,264,000, down 9.5% from the ₩1,396,000 in the previous read; the last full session ranged ₩1,250,000–1,320,000. It is below the falling 5-day (₩1,358,800), 30-day (₩1,499,933) and 100-day (₩1,797,610) and the rising 10-day (₩1,384,100) and 200-day (₩1,508,340) averages. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 4 (₩1,580,260), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: SK 海力士最新首尔收盘价为 ₩1,264,000，较上次解读时的 ₩1,396,000 下跌 9.5%；最近一个完整交易日区间为 ₩1,250,000–1,320,000。股价位于下行的 5 日（₩1,358,800）、30 日（₩1,499,933）和 100 日均线（₩1,797,610）以及上行的 10 日（₩1,384,100）和 200 日均线（₩1,508,340）下方。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、趋向交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 11月4日转为看空（₩1,580,260），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The fall broke the ₩1,379,000–1,381,000, ₩1,358,000 and ₩1,294,000–1,303,000 supports, all now resistance. Resistance is ₩1,303,000–1,320,000 (Nov 3 low, Nov 4 high), then ₩1,358,000–1,358,800 (Oct 27 low, 5-day) and ₩1,379,000–1,384,100 (10-day). Support is ₩1,238,000–1,250,000, then ₩1,204,000 and ₩1,171,000 (Oct 22 low). A close above ₩1,320,000 would target ₩1.36 million; below ₩1,238,000, ₩1.2 million.
